::: {.callout-note}
{{< include _privacy-link.qmd >}}

[Posit AI Pass](assistant-providers.qmd#posit-ai) is a hosted service that Posit operates. See [posit.ai](https://posit.ai/) for its terms and privacy policy. Every other AI model provider you can connect in Positron is a third-party service, and that provider's own terms of service and privacy policy govern your use of it.

Please review your provider's website directly for complete and up-to-date details on their data practices and terms of service.
